critical_code_review_comments: Quotes.jsx resetQuoteForm (~4064) and initial state (~173) hardcode requires_pinpad_config: true (no client_segment); harmless because openWizard overrides it, but any future path opening wizard without openWizard would default CORP to Sí.
DirectProjectCreation server Select falls back to hardcoded ['Multicomercio MSC','Multicomercio MSC2'] if /api/servers fails/empty — acceptable but silently masks API errors.
Fiscal printer catalog contains 'Sin Modelo definido — Sin modelo' alongside the 'Sin impresora fiscal' option — potentially confusing duplicate semantics (data issue, not code).

Absence of 'Configuración dispositivo (Pinpad o POS)' in setup_items for CORP verified via UI note + code path (initializeSetupConcepts filters when requiresPinpadConfig=false); setup items table itself not inspected since it requires choosing client/integrator.
